graduation.quote: Japanese robo-advisory startup WealthNavi secures $15M series B from SBI, others

note: Tokyo robo-adviser founded April 2015; IVP backed it from the seed stage (a search snippet cites TechCrunch Japan for a July 2015 ¥50M seed from IVP, page not loadable) and joined the October 2015 ¥600M round.
